adapter-entry-point.method: Accepted Workspace CLI Capability validation and byte-identical canonical Provider Entry Point generation

repository-read-contract.method: Repository behavioral tests prove complete Notes-owned Toulmin input, exact promoted-claim identity, developing and monitoring thesis arguments, existing relationships, deterministic digests, approved reads only, and unavailable, malformed, stale, or authority-ambiguous refusal

semantic-bearing-and-provenance.method: Repository contract tests prove exact provenance reuse regardless of lifecycle status, duplicate and ambiguous identity refusal, bounded complete coverage, exact anchors, and explicit rejection of holdings, ticker overlap, keyword overlap, and provider recommendation as semantic proof

decision-boundary.method: Repository contract and recorder tests prove claim-identity and thesis-bearing ambiguity remains explicit, every refuting relation yields review_refuting_claim, tentative supporting or foundational relations yield confirm_claim_link, authorized Decision Items remain unresolved with resolution null, and coupled authorization prevents a required Decision Item from being omitted

atomic-recorder.method: Repository recorder and production-adapter tests prove exact two-table routing, user-only authorization, serializable transaction and lock, current-state revalidation, exact relationship reuse, idempotent retry, safe race retry, complete digest-bound audit, and rollback after injected partial failure

authority-boundary.method: Repository CLI, contract, adapter, and recorder tests prove refusal of main-claim creation, status or Decision Item resolution, strategies, positions, trades, direct APIs, Supabase MCP, ad-hoc SQL, generic writes, schedulers, credentials, provider discovery, and active cutover

provider-semantic-equivalence.method: Compared the exact Claude adapter with issue #59, parent #46, predecessor #47, accepted claims-synthesis and research-publication contracts, CONTEXT.md, canonical relate-research intent, and Notes/Trade Journal authority; representative output was used without live provider invocation and is bound to exact adapter bytes

eligible-environment.method: The configured repository runtime completed non-mutating CLI help, focused preparation/refusal validation, controlled-memory transaction tests, and production-adapter routing tests on 2026-08-09; missing database, source, provider, authorization, or sandbox prerequisites remain explicit unavailable or refused outcomes
